'''Association Sportive la Jeunesse d'Esch/Alzette''', usually abbreviated to '''Jeunesse Esch''', is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Esch-sur-Alzette]], in south-western [[Luxembourg]]. The side play in the {{Luxembourg football updater|JEU4}}, and have won the league title on 28 occasions between 1921 and 2010, the most of any team in Luxembourg.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesl/luxhist.html|website=[[RSSSF]]|title=Luxembourg – List of Final Tables}}</ref>"}}
